SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. P. REGISTER
Special Branch No. 2 Station,
No. S. B. D. 1468
Date June 30, 1930.
ate 22 - 7 - 30.）

File No.

Subject (in full) Samuel Isakovitch Tiles.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by W Kunean K S I

Information has been received that an Enquiry Agency
has been opened by Samuel Isakovitch Tiles under the
name of "Enquiry & Protective Agency of Shanghai," with
offices at No. 18B Central Arcade. He is a Russian Jew,
about 22 years of age, native of Ekaterinoslov, South
Russia, and resides at Apt. 5, Luck Terrace, Avenue
Joffre. He opened his agency on May 15, 1930 previous to
which he was employed as a checker of entry tickets at
the "Capitol Theatre" for about one year and five months,
but was dismissed owing to neglect of duty. Previously
he was engaged with his father as a peddler of soap which
they manufactured themselves. His father left for Tsingtao
where he has a motor car for hire. So far Tiles has
conducted very little business and should it not improve
he is expected to close down.
There is nothing known against Tiles, but his
father had a very shady reputation.

g. Tcheremshansky.
D. S.

D. C.
(C. & S. Branches)

上海公共租界工部局警务处
报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别警务处登记簿
特别分部第2站，
编号 S. B. D. 1468
日期 1930年6月30日。
日期 30 - 7 - 22。）

档案编号

事由（全称） 塞缪尔·伊萨科维奇·泰尔斯 (Samuel Isakovitch Tiles)。

呈报人 D.S. 切列姆尚斯基 (Tcheremshansky)。转呈人 W Kunean K S I

据获情报，塞缪尔·伊萨科维奇·泰尔斯以“上海调查与保护社” (Enquiry & Protective Agency of Shanghai) 之名开设了一家调查机构，办公地点位于中央商场 (Central Arcade) 18B号。此人为俄罗斯犹太人，年约22岁，原籍南俄叶卡捷琳诺斯拉夫 (Ekaterinoslov)，现居霞飞路 (Avenue Joffre) 乐克公寓 (Luck Terrace) 5号。他于1930年5月15日开设该机构，在此之前，他在“首都大戏院” (Capitol Theatre) 担任入场券检票员约一年零五个月，后因玩忽职守被解雇。此前，他与其父一同从事肥皂叫卖生意，该肥皂由其父子自行制造。其父已前往青岛，在那里拥有一辆出租汽车。迄今为止，泰尔斯的业务寥寥无几，若情况不见好转，预计他将停业。

目前未发现泰尔斯有任何不良记录，但其父名声极差。

g. 切列姆尚斯基 (Tcheremshansky)。
D. S.

D. C.
（刑事与特别分部）
